glosses: A person who is intentionally physically or emotionally cruel to others, especially to those whom they perceive as being vulnerable or of less power or privilege.

examples.text: A playground bully pushed a girl off the swing.

glosses: A noisy, blustering, tyrannical person, more insolent than courageous; one who is threatening and quarrelsome.
